stem: A support application receives the following Messages API response while answering a delivery-status question. The application has an authorized lookup_order implementation. Which continuation correctly completes the client-tool interaction?
context:
Actual Messages API response excerpt; fictional tool and order IDs. Top-level stop_reason is response metadata.
{
  "role": "assistant",
  "stop_reason": "tool_use",
  "content": [{"type":"tool_use", "id":"toolu_O4",
    "name":"lookup_order", "input":{"order_id":"O4"}}]
}
No lookup result has been returned yet. This stage has no payment capability.
translation: Claude is asking your program to look up the order. What must your program do, and how does it send the actual answer back to the same request?

options.text: Execute the authorized lookup, preserve the assistant role/content in the message history, then append a user message containing a tool_result with tool_use_id:"toolu_O4" and the observed lookup output.
options.why: Client tools execute in application code. The result is returned in a user message and correlated to the original tool_use.id. Preserve the assistant content, not its top-level response metadata, in the request history.

options.text: Treat stop_reason:"tool_use" as confirmation that the lookup has executed, and display the delivery status inferred from input.order_id.
options.why: The stop reason identifies a tool request, not execution or delivery evidence. An order identifier does not establish its delivery status.

options.text: Execute lookup_order, then append an assistant message containing tool_result with a new tool_use_id to represent the completed lookup.
options.why: The client result belongs in a user message. Its tool_use_id must match the requesting tool_use.id rather than identify a new operation.

options.text: Execute lookup_order, discard the assistant tool_use message, and send its output as a fresh plain-text user message to restart the model turn.
options.why: Discarding the assistant tool-use message loses the call/result relationship. Return the matching tool_result immediately after the corresponding assistant tool-use message in history.

sources.title: Anthropic: Handle client tool calls and format results

variant.constraint: The authorized lookup raises an error and returns no delivery evidence.
variant.prompt: How should the client represent this failure while preserving the call/result relationship, and what delivery claim must the application avoid?
